title: "4.1 Quality control"
body-classes: qc-manual
format:
  html:
    include-after-body: qc-legacy-links.html
---

Quality control (QC) is the visual review of HALFpipe outputs. First use [3. Run and check outputs](check_run.qmd) to confirm that processing finished and the expected files are present. Then use this guide to judge whether those outputs are usable.

[Start the QC review](qc/before-starting.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
[Go to rating instructions](qc/reports.qmd#explore-reports){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
[Cheat Sheet](qc/cheat-sheet.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

## Workflow

::: {.qc-workflow-grid}

::: {.qc-nav-card}
[4.2 Prepare for QC](qc/before-starting.qmd){.qc-card-title}

Find the reports folder and check the summary report to see which outputs are ready to review.
:::

::: {.qc-nav-card}
[4.3 Open the QC report](qc/reports.qmd){.qc-card-title}

Open `reports/index.html` in your browser and choose **Explore reports**.
:::

::: {.qc-nav-card}
[4.4 Review and rate images](qc/review.qmd){.qc-card-title}

Inspect each available image and record a rating. Choose a report type to see what to look for and compare examples.
:::

::: {.qc-nav-card}
[4.5 Rerun if needed and export ratings](qc/rerun.qmd){.qc-card-title}

Review any updated outputs, then save your ratings.
:::

:::

## Examples by report type {#qc-categories}

[Browse the example galleries](qc/review.qmd#examples-by-report-type) for the report you are rating.
